The airflow-with-docker conda-forge package ships Airflow 3.0.1, which is beyond the fixed point of 2.3.0. The Pig Provider is a separate optional provider not included in this package, and no conda-forge versions of airflow-with-docker fall within the affected range of <2.3.0.

The PYSEC-2023-314 vulnerability is in the Apache Airflow Sqoop Provider (apache-airflow-providers-sqoop), not in core Airflow. The airflow-with-docker conda package does not include the Sqoop Provider. The OSV record's range referencing apache-airflow versions up to 3.1.1 is misleading — the actual fix was in the Sqoop Provider package version 3.1.1, which is a separate artifact entirely.

The PYSEC-2025-87 vulnerability is in the Edge3 Provider for Airflow 2, which is a separate optional provider package not included in airflow-with-docker. The advisory explicitly states Airflow 3 users are not affected. The current conda-forge version is 3.0.1 (Airflow 3), and the OSV range (fixed at 2.0.0) contradicts the advisory narrative which says the issue is specific to Airflow 2.
